Added 2026-10-29. Airness replaces JTidy r938 in the plugin-descriptor generator with the maintained com.github.jtidy:jtidy:1.0.5. That release includes the fix published in 1.0.4: excessive nesting produces a document error instead of crashing. NVD bounds the advisory at version r938, and Dependency-Check orders the release line 1.0.5 below that label. GitHub's advisory GHSA-fv2r-hw24-8rxj lists no affected Maven package, and OSV reports no advisory for this coordinate. Whether the bound matches depends on the published NVD data, so the entry can be idle for a while without being obsolete. It names only the patched coordinate and version; the vulnerable net.sf.jtidy artifact remains blocked. https://github.com/jtidy/jtidy/releases/tag/jtidy-1.0.4 https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fv2r-hw24-8rxj
Mitigation: The patched parser runs only while the Airness build generates its plugin descriptors, never in a published artifact's runtime code, and the vulnerable net.sf.jtidy artifact stays blocked. The entry is removed once NVD bounds the advisory below the maintained release line, or once the descriptor generator no longer depends on JTidy.
